methodologyNotes: Call-tracking / call-analytics software (CallRail / WhatConverts / CallTrackingMetrics class). Pricing figures were collected from each vendor's public pricing page on the accessedAt date recorded per source; where a second independent source (vendor pricing-guide, comparison roundup, or G2/Capterra listing) confirms the same figure on the same date it is attached as 'corroboration', satisfying the two-source rule. No figure is ever invented. This category bills as subscription + metered usage: most vendors charge a flat monthly base PLUS per-minute (local/toll-free), per-number, recording, and transcription fees on top, while a sub-segment (Nimbata, Infinity) bills per ANSWERED CALL instead of per minute. Plans are normalized to the dataset shape: monthlyUsd is the recurring base, minutesIncluded/callsIncluded carry bundled quota where the vendor publishes one (usually null — these platforms meter usage rather than bundle it; the entry tier's headline allowance is recorded where stated, e.g. CallRail's 250 local minutes / 5 numbers), overagePerMin is the marginal local per-minute rate and overagePerCall the per-answered-call rate. Toll-free per-minute, recording, transcription, SMS and per-number rates are preserved in plan notes rather than dropped. IMPORTANT FABRICATION-GUARD NOTE: several vendors (CallRail, WhatConverts, WildJar, Convirza) publish a SINGLE platform-wide per-minute overage that applies identically to every tier rather than a per-plan rate; to avoid presenting a falsely uniform column, that single rate is recorded once on the relevant tier(s) with the platform-wide caveat in notes, not copied across all plans. Quote-only / sales-gated vendors (Invoca, Phonexa, Marchex, CallSource, Retreaver) carry empty plans[] with a provenance note stating where pricing was sought and why no figure was recorded — never a guessed number. Per-minute developer-style metering means the cost normalizer must combine base + (minutes x rate). HIPAA/BAA and integration fields reflect what each vendor states publicly; null means not published, not absence. This is a static snapshot intended to be refreshed from our scheduled public-page monitoring pipeline.

vendors.name: CallRail

plans.name: Lead Tracking
plans.notes: Entry tier: 5 local tracking numbers + 250 local minutes included. Platform-wide usage rates: local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.065/min, SMS $0.03/msg. Annual up to ~10% off.

plans.name: Lead Tracking Complete
plans.notes: Adds form tracking & multi-touch cost-per-lead reporting on top of Lead Tracking. Same platform-wide usage rates apply (local $0.045/min) — not repeated per-plan to avoid a falsely uniform column.

plans.name: Lead Conversion
plans.notes: Adds Premium Conversation Intelligence (AI call summaries & sentiment). Same platform-wide usage rates.

plans.name: Lead Conversion Complete
plans.notes: Top tier: form tracking + conversation intelligence + coaching. Same platform-wide usage rates.

vendors.provenance: Four-tier 2026 plan structure (Lead Tracking $50 / Lead Tracking Complete $95 / Lead Conversion $150 / Lead Conversion Complete $195, each + metered usage) confirmed from callrail.com/pricing and corroborated by an independent 2026 pricing roundup (toolcomparelab) which lists CallRail 'From $50/mo, subscription + usage'. Entry tier bundles 5 local numbers + 250 local minutes; platform-wide usage rates local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.065/min, SMS $0.03 recorded on the entry tier only because they are a single platform rate, not per-plan figures. The market leader (700+ integrations). HIPAA/BAA available for healthcare accounts.

vendors.name: WhatConverts

plans.name: Call Tracking
plans.notes: $30/mo includes a $30 usage credit (~up to 148 calls). Platform-wide usage: local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.065/min, SMS $0.03/msg.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Adds 300 forms/chats on top of call tracking + $30 usage credit. Same platform-wide usage rates.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $30 usage credit; advanced reporting. Same platform-wide usage rates.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: $30 usage credit. Same platform-wide usage rates. Agency 'Unlimited Accounts' tiers ($500/$800/$1,250) drop overage to $0.04/min local; omitted here as a separate billing model.

vendors.provenance: Single-account tiers ($30/$60/$100/$160, each including a $30 usage credit ~148 calls) from whatconverts.com/pricing, corroborated by the toolcomparelab 2026 roundup ('From $30/mo, subscription with included usage credit + extra usage'). Platform-wide overage (local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.065/min, SMS $0.03) is a single rate recorded on the entry tier only. callsIncluded=148 is the vendor-stated ceiling implied by the $30 credit at the local rate. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: CallTrackingMetrics

plans.name: Marketing Lite
plans.notes: Unlimited users/tracking sources; 25 sub-accounts. Annual ~$65/mo (~18% off), 2-yr ~$60/mo. Usage metered: live transcription $0.02/min.

plans.name: Marketing Pro
plans.notes: 3,000 transcribed minutes included; overage $0.02/min. AskAI, HubSpot integration, white-label. HIPAA/GDPR available on this tier+. Annual ~$149/mo.

plans.name: Sales Engage
plans.notes: VoIP softphone + Smart Dialer + Salesforce. VoiceAI $0.12/min (250 min/agent included). Annual ~$274/mo.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Published list price $1,999/mo (monthly); annual/2-yr custom. 20 hrs professional services, dedicated account management.

vendors.provenance: Four-tier plan ($79/$179/$329/$1,999 monthly) from ctm.com/plans (calltrackingmetrics.com 301-redirects to ctm.com) corroborated by the toolcomparelab roundup ('From $79/mo'). Marketing Pro bundles 3,000 transcribed minutes (overage $0.02/min). HIPAA/GDPR compliance offered on Marketing Pro and higher; BAA specifics not published. Annual ~18% / 2-yr ~24% off.

vendors.name: Ringba

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Pay-per-call/inbound focus. Local $0.055/min, toll-free $0.06/min, local numbers $3/mo, recording $0.01/min, transcription $0.04/min. Annual $127/mo (~13% off). No bundled minutes.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Local $0.05/min, toll-free $0.055/min, local numbers $2/mo, recording $0.005/min, transcription $0.035/min. Annual $197/mo (~33% off). 5 Ring Tree setups/mo included.

vendors.provenance: Two published tiers (Business $147/mo, Professional $297/mo) with full per-minute/per-number metering from ringba.com/pricing, corroborated by G2's 2026 Ringba pricing listing ('$147 Business / $297 Professional'). No bundled minutes (clean metered model). Enterprise is custom-quote and omitted. HIPAA/BAA not published. Pay-per-call lead-gen vertical.

vendors.name: Nimbata

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Bills one flat rate per ANSWERED call regardless of duration (rate not published per tier). Annual ~$35/mo (from $39, up to 20% off).

plans.name: Marketing
plans.notes: Per-answered-call billing. Annual ~$80/mo (from $89).

plans.name: Agency
plans.notes: Per-answered-call billing. Annual ~$120/mo (from $149).

vendors.provenance: Tiered base ($35/$80/$120, annual-discounted from $39/$89/$149) from nimbata.com/pricing. Distinctive model: one flat charge per ANSWERED call, not per minute — the per-call rate is not published on the page so overagePerCall is left null rather than guessed. Free 'Entry' ($0 + usage) tier omitted (no base price to compare). HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: Infinity

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: UK/EU-headquartered. $0.20 per tracked call on top of base. Included call volume not published.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $0.15 per tracked call. Out-of-the-box integrations hub. Included volume not published.

vendors.provenance: Two published tiers (Essentials $249 + $0.20/call, Pro $349 + $0.15/call) from infinity.co/us/pricing, corroborated by G2's 2026 Infinity pricing listing ('start at $249/mo Essentials, $349/mo Pro, per-call charges $0.20/$0.15'). Per-CALL (not per-minute) billing. Enterprise is POA/custom and omitted. HIPAA/BAA not published.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $3.00/number, $0.08/min, SMS $0.03, MMS $0.05. Unlimited phone leads tracked; conversation analytics add-ons (transcription/scoring) from $0.02/min.

plans.name: Agency
plans.notes: $1.00/number, $0.05/min, SMS $0.025, MMS $0.045. Advanced IVR, priority support.

AI conversation-analytics add-ons (transcription/scoring/sentiment) priced separately from $0.005-$0.03/min. Enterprise custom-quote omitted. References 'Caller Privacy (HIPAA & Legal)' but does not detail HIPAA in tiers, so hipaa=null.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $0.05/min, numbers $4.50 each, SMS $0.05, call intelligence $0.04/min. No bundled minutes published.

vendors.name: Dialics

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: Pure usage: local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.055/min, local numbers $1/mo, toll-free $2/mo, transcription $0.02/min, recording $0.0025/min, SMS $0.0024. 7-day trial + $10 credit. Some third-party listings cite a ~$99/mo entry, but the live page shows pure pay-as-you-go, so base=0 is recorded.

vendors.provenance: Pure pay-as-you-go metered rates (local $0.045/min, toll-free $0.055/min, transcription $0.02/min, recording $0.0025/min, numbers $1-$2/mo) from dialics.com/call-tracking-pricing. The live page publishes no named monthly base tiers, so monthlyUsd=0 (PAYG). A ~$99/mo figure appears in some third-party directories but is not on the vendor page and is therefore NOT recorded as a plan. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: Mediahawk

plans.name: Per-user (entry)
plans.notes: UK vendor; ~$50/user/mo entry (vendor-stated USD-equivalent). Flat monthly fee + per-number + per-minute call charges (from ~2p/min). Annual up to 20% off. Per-minute USD rate not published; left null.

vendors.provenance: UK-headquartered marketing-attribution / call-analytics vendor. Per-user entry (~$50/user/mo, scaling to ~$400/mo at 10 users, ~$3,500/mo at 100) from mediahawk.co.uk/pricing; call charges from ~2p/min on top. Annual up to 20% off. Only the entry per-user base is recorded as a comparable plan; higher seat-count totals are headcount-derived, not separate published tiers. Native currency GBP; figure is vendor-stated USD-equivalent and flagged. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: Invoca
vendors.provenance: Quote-only at time of capture: invoca.com/pricing publishes tier NAMES (Pro / Enterprise / Elite, plus Performance Professional / Performance Enterprise for pay-per-call) scaled by annual phone-number volume (6,000-18,000) and Signals, but states pricing is custom and routes to a sales form. No monthly figure is published, so plans are intentionally empty rather than guessed. Best-in-category AI; enterprise-only economics. HIPAA-compliant with SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, and BAA support stated on the page (hence hipaa/baa=true).

vendors.name: Marchex
vendors.provenance: Quote-only / sales-gated: Marchex publishes no pricing on its site and third-party directories (G2, Capterra) explicitly note 'Marchex has not provided pricing.' Estimated $500+/mo ranges appear in secondary listings but are unverified against any live vendor page, so NO figure is recorded; plans intentionally empty. Enterprise conversational-analytics vendor. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: Phonexa
vendors.provenance: Quote-only: phonexa.com Call Logic (call tracking) pricing page repeatedly routes to 'Get a Custom Quote' with no published monthly price; included minutes vary by package, none stated. Plans intentionally empty rather than guessed. All-in-one lead/call distribution suite. HIPAA not mentioned on the pricing page.

vendors.name: CallSource
vendors.provenance: Quote-only: CallSource states Account Executives customize pricing by number count, anticipated monthly minutes, and optional features — no public per-plan figure. Secondary sources cite ~$1/min or ~$149/mo entry but these are unverified against a live vendor pricing page, so NO figure is recorded; plans intentionally empty. Monthly-contract incumbent. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: Retreaver
vendors.provenance: Quote-only at time of capture: retreaver.com/pricing returned HTTP 404 on 2026-06-11 and the vendor routes pricing through a sales conversation. No published per-plan figures captured; plans intentionally empty rather than guessed. Pay-per-call routing / tag-based attribution platform. HIPAA/BAA not published.

vendors.name: TrackDrive
vendors.provenance: Quote-only: TrackDrive publishes no public per-minute or monthly rates and routes to sales (the one published figure is a $0.005/call abandoned-call surcharge, not a base price). No base plan figure recorded; plans intentionally empty. Pay-per-call routing platform. HIPAA/BAA not published.
